node.title: E22 quotient-fiber locator saturation
node.statement: In the multiplicative subgroup domain, for any divisor M of the domain size and any quotient value z in the image of x -> x^M, divisibility by the fiber locator X^M-z is equivalent to containing the entire fiber {x: x^M=z}. Products of distinct such factors are therefore exactly local unions of full quotient fibers.
node.attack_surface: elementary locator identity for quotient fibers in a cyclic subgroup
node.falsifier: a quotient value z whose fiber locator is not X^M-z, or a squarefree support locator divisible by X^M-z without containing the full fiber
